intent.raw: invoke plan for the approved ide-extension manual session bridge
intent.objective: Author an execution-ready L0 plan for one human-selected, late-disclosed, read-only Codex skill request with kernel-bound result evidence.
intent.operator_sentence: Plan the L0 manual session bridge, then execute exactly one ready SWU per Task Session.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The approved design and brownfield code anchors converge on one bounded route. Invoke authors the plan locally; later Task Sessions may delegate only one isolated SWU under a separate permission gate.
receipt_requirements: Every SWU returns status, capability, receipt artifact, files, validation, blockers, residue, reroute, and handoff note.

steps.name: Build bounded planning context
stop_conditions: The approved decisions are missing, contradictory, or no longer current.
The current runtime cannot preserve v1 history without an unapproved migration.

steps.name: Author layered split plan
stop_conditions: An executable task lacks a SWU, source handle, write scope, done criteria, or validation.
The active plan imports authentication, leases, workers, mutation, remote adapters, or IDE chrome into L0.

steps.name: Validate units and recomposition
convergence_criteria: SWU-MSB-001 is executable without hidden product discovery.
All eleven SWUs recompose into the approved L0 witness.
L1-L3 authority and all known residue remain explicit.
stop_conditions: An acceptance-critical gap lacks an owner and treatment.

steps.name: Execute contract and kernel waves

outputs.ref: Task Session result for SWU-MSB-001 through SWU-MSB-005

steps.evidence_artifact: one immutable Task Session result per selected SWU
stop_conditions: No explicit ready SWU is selected.
v1 replay, receipt separation, singleton targeting, claim secrecy, or result binding fails.

steps.name: Execute session and workbench wave

outputs.ref: Task Session results for SWU-MSB-006 through SWU-MSB-008

steps.evidence_artifact: CLI protocol and workbench test results
stop_conditions: The session client gains operator authority or background execution.
The workbench overclaims identity or execution.

steps.name: Prove and close the L0 witness

outputs.ref: automated, browser, manual witness, and closure evidence

steps.evidence_artifact: SWU-MSB-009..011 results plus readiness closure report
stop_conditions: The private skill was known before claim or the result remains chat-only.
The live manual witness is unavailable; return block instead of simulation.

gates.condition: Layering, work-pack, tasks, SWUs, waves, first route, and validation surfaces are complete and navigable.
Smallest-unit, recomposition, hidden-gap, deferred-complexity, and navigation checks pass.
The operator selects exactly one ready SWU before each Task Session mutation.
L0 completion does not admit L1-L3 leases, authentication, mutation, workers, IDE/browser control, providers, or remote adapters.
Authorization, claim, execution, and readiness remain separate authorities with separate evidence.

boundaries.contract: Task Session receives exactly one selected SWU and returns the structured result before status synchronization.
Operator authorizes and targets; kernel claims/adjudicates/receipts; session only claims, interrupts, and submits a bound result.
The real blind witness is performed manually after automated/browser gates and may return block or interrupted.

authority.execution: task-session for one selected SWU; active Codex only for the final witness
authority.validation: SWU owner, automated suites, Playwright, and closure audit
authority.evidence: Task Session receipts plus ide-extension kernel receipts/artifacts
authority.memory: Invoke plan artifacts; no Craft or inventory mutation
authority.promotion: human approval through the owning lifecycle

state_namespaces.owner: invoke plan until handoff; then target lifecycle
state_namespaces.write_policy: Planning artifacts only during Invoke; no source implementation.
Write only the exact SWU scope; preserve v1 event history.
Disclose to the session only through a successful claim; publish only review-safe evidence.

promotion_splits.target: L1-L3 reliable, authenticated, effectful, or packaged routing
promotion_splits.rule: L0 completion does not promote later layers; each needs a separate approved design and plan.

promotion_guardrails: No runtime implementation occurs during Invoke plan.
No Task Session begins without one selected ready SWU.
No v1 event history is rewritten to simulate v2 evidence.
No unattested session is described as authenticated.
No real witness failure is rewritten or simulated as success.
No L0 proof promotes L1-L3 authority.
